desc:
🦖 Start as a tiny egg, then a baby dinosaur, and evolve into the ULTIMATE DINOSAUR! 🦕

🍖 Eat food and hunt animals to grow bigger!
⚔️ Bite, attack, and battle other dinosaurs and players!
🧬 Roll mutations like fire, wings, and toxic powers!
🦖 Take down the GIANT T-REX boss!
🔁 Rebirth for permanent power and unlock stronger evolutions!

👍 Like and Favorite Game for more Updates ⭐️
